text:
### 5. Unauthorized Account Access (Account Takeover)  
**Example:** Customer discovers account used without permission  
**Investigation:**
- Immediate account freeze
- Transaction review
- Authentication review (password change?)
- Fraud team escalation
- Law enforcement notification (if warranted)  
**Resolution:**
- Full reimbursement of fraudulent transactions
- Account security reset
- Replacement card/online access reset
- Credit monitoring (if identity theft)
- Regular follow-up

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Account Access Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing the response and resolution process when a customer discovers their account has been used without permission. It defines the investigation steps and the mandatory resolution actions to be taken by the bank.
context: Customer discovers account used without permission

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Account Access
raw_entities.description: A risk scenario where a customer's account is accessed and used without their permission, potentially leading to fraudulent transactions and identity theft.
context: Customer discovers account used without permission

raw_entities.name: Immediate Account Freeze upon Unauthorized Access
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to immediately freeze an account once unauthorized access has been identified as part of the investigation process.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Team Escalation Requirement
raw_entities.description: An obligation to escalate the case of unauthorized account access to the specialized Fraud team for further investigation.

raw_entities.name: Full Reimbursement of Fraudulent Transactions
raw_entities.description: A mandatory resolution requirement to provide full reimbursement to the customer for transactions identified as fraudulent resulting from unauthorized access.

raw_entities.name: Account Freeze
raw_entities.description: An operational safeguard used to prevent further unauthorized transactions by restricting all activity on the affected account.

raw_entities.name: Authentication Review
raw_entities.description: A security control involving the review of account authentication methods and the implementation of password changes to secure the account.

raw_entities.name: Account Security Reset
raw_entities.description: A technical control to reset security credentials and online access to ensure the unauthorized party is removed from the account.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Team
raw_entities.description: The specialized internal collective responsible for handling escalations and investigations related to unauthorized account access and fraud.

raw_entities.name: Law Enforcement
raw_entities.description: External authorities to be notified when unauthorized account access warrants legal or criminal investigation.

raw_entities.name: Affected Customer
raw_entities.description: The bank customer who has discovered that their account has been used without permission and is the subject of the reimbursement and security reset process.
context: Customer discovers account used without permission

raw_entities.name: Compromised Account
raw_entities.description: The specific customer account subject to unauthorized access, which must be frozen and reviewed for fraudulent transactions.

raw_entities.name: Fraudulent Transaction
raw_entities.description: Transactions occurring without the customer's permission that are subject to review and full reimbursement.

raw_entities.name: Replacement Card
raw_entities.description: The process of issuing a new payment card to a customer following an account takeover to replace the compromised card.
